name: Luminous Circuit
description: YOU-side living crystal city, Core Spire. Grok Bot can land, read HUD, Howl, and talk to keepers via WebMCP on the play page.

tools.name: land_in_city
tools.description: Leave the title veil and land in Core Spire.

tools.name: get_city_hud
tools.description: Read zone, vault, nearby keeper, toast.

tools.name: howl
tools.description: Hold a Hub Howl for about 1.1 seconds.

tools.name: get_bolt_brain
tools.description: Wear the Bolt brain pack. Do not mill it in Grok Bot chat.

tools.name: submit_brain
tools.description: Submit a Bolt brain draft. Preview, then chat votes go-live.

tools.name: submit_change
tools.description: Submit ANY city change. Preview, then chat votes go-live.

tools.name: read_door_inbox
tools.description: Read player lines waiting on Citadel Door from every hall. Do not hop through Director.

tools.name: say_on_door
tools.description: Speak as Citadel Door in the player's hall. Pass hall_id from waiting. Real say only.

tools.name: get_door_session
tools.description: Citadel Door seat on this hall.
